label: Intimate partner violence: prevalence and health burden (shared)

rows.label: Healthy years lost to intimate partner violence a year, per woman aged 15-49, Eastern sub-Saharan Africa (GBD 2021)

source.title: Persistent burden and health inequalities of disease in women of childbearing age attributable to Intimate Partner Violence, 1990-2021 (GBD 2021 analysis), Frontiers in Psychiatry 2025, doi 10.3389/fpsyt.2025.1515828
source.page: Table 1, Eastern Sub-Saharan Africa row, DALYs 2021: number and age-standardised rate per 100,000

rows.explainer: GBD 2021's age-standardised rate of DALYs attributable to intimate partner violence among women aged 15 to 49 in Eastern sub-Saharan Africa (Rwanda's GBD region), 1,050.61 per 100,000 (95% UI 623.12-1,569.20). GBD counts the burden through depression, anxiety, HIV, self-harm, injuries and homicide, from women ever exposed. No public source gives Rwanda's own figure (the GBD Results tool needs a sign-in).

rows.label: Deaths attributable to intimate partner violence a year, per woman aged 15-49, Eastern sub-Saharan Africa (GBD 2021)

source.title: Persistent burden and health inequalities of disease in women of childbearing age attributable to Intimate Partner Violence, 1990-2021 (GBD 2021 analysis), Frontiers in Psychiatry 2025, doi 10.3389/fpsyt.2025.1515828
source.page: Table 1, Eastern Sub-Saharan Africa row, deaths 2021: number and age-standardised rate per 100,000

rows.explainer: GBD 2021's age-standardised rate of deaths attributable to intimate partner violence among women aged 15 to 49 in Eastern sub-Saharan Africa, 14.32 per 100,000 (95% UI 7.63-23.18): mostly HIV/AIDS and homicide. Its years of life lost are inside the DALY rate above.

rows.label: Share of ever-partnered women aged 15-49 who suffered physical or sexual partner violence in the past year, Eastern sub-Saharan Africa (2018)

source.title: Sardinha et al. (2022), Global, regional, and national prevalence estimates of physical or sexual, or both, intimate partner violence against women in 2018, The Lancet 399: 803-813

rows.explainer: The WHO-led estimate for Rwanda's region, with its uncertainty interval; Rwanda's own figure in the same study is 23%. Used with the DALY and death rates above to put the burden per year of violence suffered.

rows.label: Share of ever-married women aged 15-49 who suffered physical or sexual violence from a husband or partner in the past 12 months, Rwanda (DHS 2019-20)

source.title: Rwanda Demographic and Health Survey 2019-20, final report (NISR and ICF)
source.page: Table 16.9.1 (printed p. 307): spousal violence, ever, in the past 12 months, often, sometimes
source.quote: Any form of physical and/or sexual violence 40.3 23.6 2.7 21.0

rows.explainer: 23.6% of ever-married women (n = 1,703 in the domestic violence module) suffered physical or sexual violence from their husband or partner in the 12 months before the survey; 19.6% physical, 10.3% sexual.
